ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low white-to-black ratio; approximately 95% low-intensity (dark) pixels with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to localized scarring and edge clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark field dominant. High-contrast white circular ring clusters localized on the right lobe. High-intensity white clusters (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 50 degrees and a deep vertical bounding box depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, moderate-frequency serrations with pixel-amplitude peaks ranging from 5-15 pixels. High-amplitude jaggedness observed on the distal end of the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory from the median notch extending to the tips, exhibiting a slight S-curve sweep on the trailing edge of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple (6+) distinct high-contrast circular rings (white on black background) on the medial section of the right lobe. Dense white cluster constellations at the top-left and top-right terminal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct vertical high-contrast linear pixel disruptions (white rake marks) detected on the right lobe, approximately midway between the notch and the tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent circular white ring scars likely originating from previous barnacle or lamprey attachments; dense barnacle colonization on the lateral fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant high-contrast pixel density at the leftmost fluke tip indicative of a dense barnacle colony extending beyond the primary fluke boundary.
